title: Radio: Summit Drive — 24-inch break confirmed

fields.orgName: City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer

lines.text: Control, Distribution 3 at Summit Drive. Confirmed: the 24-inch is open under the eastbound lane, water across the road and into two yards, the pavement is undermined. Police are closing Summit Drive.
We’re going to V-2410 first. Somebody pull the card on V-2418 — it hasn’t been turned since 2023.

fields.voiceStyle: Man in his 50s, loud over rushing water

instructorNote: Watch for the fewest-valves isolation and the second crew sent to V-2418 early.

snapshot.title: Radio Call: Mill Road Booster Station Manual Override Attempt

fields.orgName: City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer

lines.text: Control, this is Field Crew 4 at the Mill Road Booster Station. The local HMI shows BP-401 and BP-402 in HAND mode, but the switches are not engaged. The manual override lever is frozen. We’re calling for a second technician to assist with the override. The main break has caused the zone to lose pressure, and we need to start the boosters manually to hold Zone 2.
Field Crew 4, copy. We are not seeing any remote HMI access to RTU-04. Confirm the override lever is physically frozen, not just stuck in position.
Affirmative. The lever is frozen solid. We’ve tried the wrench and the lever pliers — no movement. We’re requesting immediate backup from the maintenance team. We cannot proceed alone.

snapshot.instructorNote: Noise inject; the technical team should triage the manual override issue and not attempt remote control. The frozen lever is a physical failure, not a software glitch.
